description_en: Modifies the IP address whitelist for a Supabase project
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb modify-supabase-project-security-ips --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --security-ip-list 127.0.0.1 --project-id sbp-4070000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySupabaseProjectSecurityIps

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html to view available region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html接口查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of IP addresses for the whitelist. Up to 1,000 IP addresses are supported. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas. The following formats are supported:

10.23.12.24 (IP address)

10.23.12.24/24 (A CIDR block, where `/24` indicates the prefix length. The prefix length must be an integer in the range `[1,32]`.)
parameters.help_zh:
IP白名单分组下的IP列表，最多1000个，以逗号隔开，格式如下：
10.23.12.24（IP）
10.23.12.24/24（CIDR模式，无类域间路由，`/24`表示地址中前缀的长度，范围为`[1,32]`）
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to modify the whitelist for database port 5432. The default value is true
parameters.help_zh: 是否修改数据库5432端口的白名单，默认true
parameters.name: update_db

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to modify the whitelist for HTTP port 80 and HTTPS port 443. The default value is true
parameters.help_zh: 是否修改http 80和https 443端口的白名单，默认true
parameters.name: update_web
